scope: Targeted final build retest: compact viewport harness corrections, secondary action contrast on six sizes, mobile menu keyboard behavior
methodology: Initial main run had two 360px harness failures: assertion included an offscreen second card; native touch started beneath fixed header. This retest observes first visible card and centers slider in real viewport. No product fix was needed for those two cases. Product changes after main run are navbar end-of-document active state, modal keyboard focus handling and results action color/background. All relevant controls are retested separately.
